text:
Find useful events without reading every host log. Review retained lines, search them or forward new matches. Start with sources and tail; marks and retained history are lost on restart.
tail [n]: Review the latest retained lines, oldest first. No search filter is applied.
  n (int): 1..100000; default 20
grep <query> [n]: Find matching lines in retained history. Searching happens only when requested.
  query (string): Plain case-insensitive text or /regex/imsu
  n (int): Maximum lines; default 20
since <age> [n]: Review lines received during a recent interval. Age is based on receipt time, not dates inside the log text.
  age (string): Positive duration such as 30s, 5m, 1h or 1d
  n (int): Maximum lines; default 20
mark [label]: Save the current place in history for a later after call. Marks and history do not survive restart.; returns: Mark label
  label (string): Unique name; generated when omitted
after <label>: Review retained lines strictly after a saved mark. A mark that has expired is refused.
  label (string): Mark label
sources: Find watched files and journal units, exclusions, counts, last lines and errors.
stats: Check how much history is retained and how many lines were seen or dropped. The reply also includes uptime and version.
sub add <target> [filter]: Receive each matching new line once, including repeated lines. The author must be allowed to send to this helper and the destination.; returns: Subscription ID
  target (string): Destination queue or agent; author send rights are checked at add and for every copy
  filter (string): Optional shared portable regex, bare or /pattern/imsu; empty matches every new line
sub list: Review your subscriptions, creation times, sent and dropped counts. Direct Owners and Maintainers see all, including inert damaged rows.
[destructive] sub delete <id>: Stop your subscription. Direct Owners and Maintainers may delete any subscription, including damaged rows.
  id (string): Subscription ID

Examples
agent-bus call '#logwatch@parf.us' 'tail 5'
agent-bus call '#logwatch@parf.us' 'grep error 5'
agent-bus call '#logwatch@parf.us' 'since 5m 5'
agent-bus call '#logwatch@parf.us' 'sources'
agent-bus call '#logwatch@parf.us' 'stats'
agent-bus call '#logwatch@parf.us' 'sub list'

tail.help: Review the latest retained lines, oldest first. No search filter is applied.

grep.help: Find matching lines in retained history. Searching happens only when requested.

since.help: Review lines received during a recent interval. Age is based on receipt time, not dates inside the log text.

mark.help: Save the current place in history for a later after call. Marks and history do not survive restart.

after.help: Review retained lines strictly after a saved mark. A mark that has expired is refused.

sources.help: Find watched files and journal units, exclusions, counts, last lines and errors.

stats.help: Check how much history is retained and how many lines were seen or dropped. The reply also includes uptime and version.

args.name: target
args.help: Destination queue or agent; author send rights are checked at add and for every copy

args.name: filter
args.help: Optional shared portable regex, bare or /pattern/imsu; empty matches every new line

sub.list.help: Review your subscriptions, creation times, sent and dropped counts. Direct Owners and Maintainers see all, including inert damaged rows.

sub.delete.help: Stop your subscription. Direct Owners and Maintainers may delete any subscription, including damaged rows.

help.help: Find available calls. Use help-config for configuration and help-secret for environment key names.

sources.help: Absolute file patterns and/or syslog; new files start at EOF

excludes.help: Absolute excluded file patterns; see guide for tail-all defaults

rescan_interval.help: Seconds between source rescans, a number from 0.05 to 86400

journal.help: List of exact unit names, or all; account must have journal read access

line_bytes.help: Maximum UTF-8 bytes per line including truncation marker, 128..1048576

ring_bytes.help: Maximum retained UTF-8 source/text bytes, oldest evicted first, 128..67108864

startup_bytes.help: Maximum bytes read from each file at startup, 128..1048576
